materials.em_model_metal: zero-thickness PEC surfaces for the first-order baseline

photo_calibration.description: Projective calibration from sixteen 2.54 mm-pitch header holes in the high-resolution top photograph.

antenna.description: Top-layer exposed ENIG copper polygon traced from the high-resolution photograph. The two roots are the narrow RF-feed branch and the wider grounded short branch.

stitching_vias.description: Primary ground-edge via fence extracted from the high-resolution top photograph.

port.type: 50 ohm vertical lumped port from the top feed pad to the bottom ground plane

important_assumptions: The matte white antenna-shaped artwork on the bottom product photograph is treated as silkscreen, not copper. Only the top antenna polygon is conductive.

The exact solder-mask-obscured ground-pour voids and component traces cannot be recovered from photographs. The baseline therefore uses continuous top and bottom ground planes in the main board region, with a measured feed clearance and grounded short bridge at the antenna edge.
The RF matching components between the CH582 and the antenna are not included. S11 is referenced directly at the antenna feed root.
The primary ground-edge via fence is included explicitly. Farther-away ground vias and component pads are omitted from the first-order baseline.
The feed and short connections under solder mask are reconstructed from visible trace direction and standard inverted-F antenna topology.
